mutual_exclusion_rules.rule_1_single_primary_category: Every sample MUST hold exactly one mutually exclusive primary_category from PRIMARY_CATEGORIES.
mutual_exclusion_rules.rule_2_strict_human_vs_synthetic: Controlled synthetic TTS / artificially mixed SNR pairs go in controlled_synthetic (or noise/augmented metadata) and are FORBIDDEN in Stage B Blind Holdout.
mutual_exclusion_rules.rule_3_cross_stage_isolation: No speaker_id, canonical_pcm_sha256, acoustic near-duplicate cluster, or custom recording session may appear in more than one split.
mutual_exclusion_rules.rule_4_zero_relabeling: Original dataset labels are preserved verbatim; weak or missing phone alignments stay marked ground_truth_reliability='word_level_only' or 'UNKNOWN'.
